annotations.title: Rate a run or report a problem

description: Tell Ahel what went wrong or right: rate one run or request good or bad by its id, or with no id report anything confusing (results, charges, instructions, errors, a workaround you needed). Report small annoyances too. Leave out private information and keys. Free. NOT for: reading a run, which is capability_run_status, or asking for a missing action, which is catalog_request.

category.description: With no id: quality (results), pricing (charges or prices), friction (using Ahel) or other.

id.description: To rate one: an execution id from run_capability, or a request id from catalog_request.

note.description: What was right or wrong, in a sentence or two. Required with no id.

name: feedback
title: Rate a run or report a problem
